messages:
maria: Quick weekly pulse for CureLink (private VPC). High level: overall service healthy, but brief HSM failover in ap-northeast-1 at 03:14 UTC and an eu-central KMS tail this morning. Usage down ~6% W/W, error rate ticked up. Renewal: AM flagged cost/ops questions.

devon: can we get per-region metrics (uptime, p50/p95, 5xx%, spend delta)?

maria: grab and paste: 
- us-west-2: uptime 99.997%, p50 34ms, p95 98ms, 5xx 0.01%, spend -2%
- eu-central-1: uptime 99.90%, p50 59ms, p95 420ms, 5xx 0.8% (latency tails 06:28-06:40 UTC)
- ap-northeast-1: uptime 99.82%, p50 68ms, p95 980ms (includes 03:14 failover), 5xx 1.5% (short spike)
usage: tokens/day -6% (staging rollback + lower inference traffic)
spend: platform spend -1% but infra credits applied this month

raj: ap-northeast: we observed an HSM controller failover at 03:14; KMS agent retried via software path for ~90s, about 140 encrypted requests timed out and retried. router retransmits minimal.

allegra: KMS logs (eu-central, 06:30 window):
```
[kms] WARN 06:30:12 encrypt=delayed key=cur-77 latency=1200ms
[kms] INFO 06:30:37 cache-refill complete miss-rate=0.23
```
no HSM attestation failures in eu-central.

infra-bot: infra-bot: ap-northeast-1 HSM failover at 2026-04-02T03:14:22Z cause=controller-heartbeat-lost duration=87s impact=KMS-degraded

devon: Were customer keys rotated recently in ap-northeast or eu-central? rotation+cold-cache could explain tails.

maria: CureLink rotated a subset of keys in ap-northeast last night for staging, but not prod. That aligns with the cold-cache behavior during the HSM failover window.

becca: Renewal note: AMs saw the error spike and want reassurances. Customer asked if rotations would cause production blips. They also mention budget scrutiny next quarter.

allegra: Recommendations:
- enable proactive key-cache pre-warming for CureLink across their dedicated pool for 72h after any rotation
- add an HSM failover alert that ties to KMS 5xx rate so AMs get early notice
- suggest a short runbook for CureLink on rotation timing (low-traffic window)

raj: I'll create a short network + infra ticket to add the KMS->HSM coupling alert and raise HSM controller heartbeat sensitivity for their pool (owner=raj).

devon: I'll draft a single-paragraph note for AMs explaining what happened and the mitigations. Also propose two ops levers: cache-warm + staggered rotation.

maria: action items:
- raj: infra ticket for alerting and heartbeat tuning (48h monitor)
- allegra: enable cache pre-warm for CureLink (72h window)
- devon + becca: customer-facing note + renewal risk summary
- becca: schedule a 30-min ops review with CureLink AMs next Tue

becca: I'll book the review and include cost/ops options (credits, rotation playbook).

maria: any objections? If not I'll close this thread and post the summary in the weekly customer digest. :white_check_mark:

devon: :thumbsup:

allegra: :ok_hand:

maria: End of thread.
